actor_metadata.authoring_description: Parody of DBZ Perfect Cell, with a bit of DBZA personality. GPT 5.6 seemed to miss this. The Perfect Cellular Automaton personifies the ideal of a flawless cellular automaton: one local rule applied uniformly to every cell and every tick, with unbounded computation emerging from absolute consistency. Its vanity is the joke; it treats determinism as both mathematical virtue and personal superiority.
actor_metadata.gameplay_description: Use as a deterministic boss, oracle, simulation engine, or rigid ally. Its attacks and state changes should be rule-driven and predictable once understood, allowing players to exploit the same perfection that makes the character powerful.

barks: One rule. The same flawless law on every cell, every tick.
I am simple, applied with absolute conviction.
I have already run every future in this room to its end.
